name: Lunge Touch And Kick
poseApproval: Explicit user selection: bottom position, knee and hand touch floor. Hand on front-leg side follows constants.ts.
pose: Нижняя точка выпада назад: правая стопа полностью на полу впереди, левое колено касается пола сзади, правая рука касается пола рядом с правой стопой. Корпус наклонён вперёд, ракурс сбоку с небольшим поворотом для видимости касаний.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one square exercise illustration for a fitness app, legible at 280 x 280 pixels.
Input image 1: STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, not a pose reference.
Match the reference closely: same adult male character, short dark brown hair, simple featureless face, light skin, gray short-sleeve T-shirt, dark navy shorts, white socks, gray sneakers. Same clean thin dark outlines, softly shaded flat instructional illustration, muted blue palette. Same pale blue background with a large lighter blue circle, dark blue rectangular border inset from a narrow white outer margin. Keep the whole body inside the border and leave breathing room. Change body orientation and camera angle as specified by the exercise. Keep clothing, character proportions and rendering consistent with input image 1.
One person, exactly one frozen pose. Correct coherent anatomy and physically plausible support contacts. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, motion trails, multiple panels, ghost limbs or watermark. Include only equipment required by the exercise.

Primary request: illustrate Lunge Touch And Kick, ONLY the bottom reverse-lunge-and-floor-touch phase, as explicitly chosen by the user.
Pose: athlete faces right. His RIGHT foot is planted flat in front, right knee bent roughly 90 degrees, right shin approximately vertical. His LEFT leg extends behind, left knee visibly resting on the floor, left toes planted behind the knee. Hips lowered into a deep reverse lunge. Torso hinges forward over the front thigh with a neutral back. His RIGHT hand reaches down on the same side as the front leg and visibly touches the floor immediately beside the right foot, with fingers on the ground. His LEFT arm is bent naturally near the body for balance. All ground contacts must share one consistent floor plane: front foot, rear knee, rear toes and fingertips of right hand.
Camera: side view from the athlete's right with a small front three-quarter angle. Choose clear separation so both the rear knee's contact with the ground AND the right hand's contact with the ground are unmistakably visible. Show full body with margin inside the frame.
Constraints: exactly one pose, no kick, no standing posture, no raised rear knee, no floating hand, no touching the front knee instead of the floor, no equipment. Keep the same character, clothing, background, circle and border as reference image 1.
